# Flood Relief Nepal

> Independent public guide for Bhotekoshi flood relief in Nepal. A flash flood came down the Bhote Koshi river on 26 August 2026, hitting Rasuwa, Nuwakot, and neighbouring districts. This site lists official government donation channels, drop-off hubs, and scam checks. It is not a government website and does not collect money itself.

## Key facts

- Cash and supplies for Bhotekoshi relief are supposed to go through one door: the Prime Minister's Disaster Relief Fund. The Ministry of Finance says the rule covers people, companies, donor agencies, and foreign organisations.
- Private groups are not authorised to collect cash or goods for this disaster. Finance officials called independent collection drives illegal; the Home Ministry has orders to shut them down.
- Card, UPI (Fonepay QR), and Alipay+ (NepalPAY QR): https://pmdrf.nchl.com.np/
- Alipay+ apps that can scan NepalPAY QR are the ones NCHL lists (Alipay, AlipayHK, MPay, Touch 'n Go eWallet, MyPB, GCash, Changi Pay, OCBC Digital, BigPay, Starryblu, KakaoPay, Naver Pay, Toss Pay, TrueMoney, Hipay, Tinaba, Bluecode): https://nchl.com.np/alipay-mobile-payments-partner/
- Second government gateway, quotes in USD: https://pmrelieffund.himalayanbank.com/
- Bank transfer / SWIFT: account name "PRIME MINISTER DISASTER RELIEF FUND". Full account and SWIFT table is on the page below, sourced from the Nepal Embassy, India post.
- No ceiling on how much can be sent: Nepal Rastra Bank lifted digital transfer caps into the two Prime Minister funds.
- Reported total raised: Rs 273.3 million (about $1.79 million) in the first six hours, per the Ministry of Finance, as reported 27 August 2026.
- Scam warning: the Nepal Police Cyber Bureau has warned of fake QR codes and cloned relief pages. A QR code or bank detail that arrived in a chat is not verified — only pmdrf.nchl.com.np and pmrelieffund.himalayanbank.com are official.

## Pages

- [English guide](https://floodreliefnepal.com/): donation channels (UPI, Alipay+, card, SWIFT), supply drop-off hubs, scam checks, FAQ, sources.
- [Nepali guide](https://floodreliefnepal.com/np/): the same content in Nepali.
- [Chinese guide](https://floodreliefnepal.com/zh/): the same content in Simplified Chinese.

- Full source list, with notes, is on the guide pages above under "Sources."
